title: Claude News Overlay (design)
hypothesis: A pinned LLM reading point-in-time news can improve the regime de-risk.
question: Can a language model reading only news published before each date add information the price-based overlay lacks?
prior: News carries information prices take time to absorb, but LLM backtests are prone to training-data look-ahead.
citations: Lopez-Lira, A. & Tang, Y. (2023). Can ChatGPT Forecast Stock Price Movements? SSRN 4412788.
method: Pinned models; backtest starts after the model's training cutoff; point-in-time news archive; at most 3 prompt trials, pre-registered.
verdict_reason: Infrastructure built (pinned models, news archive, ledger with zero decision trials); paused before backfill.
lessons: The look-ahead controls have to be designed before the first trial, not after.
footer: Research code is private; methods summarised below.
